title: Legazpi Diocese holds pontifical coronation of Marian image

blocks.text: LEGAZPI CITY — The Diocese of Legazpi held a pontifical coronation of the image of Nuestra Señora de Salvación during a Mass on Wednesday to mark the 75th anniversary of its canonical establishment. More than 6,000 faithful and hundreds of priests attended the celebration at Saint Gregory the Great Cathedral, presided over by Luis Antonio Cardinal Tagle, dean of the College of Cardinals. In his homily, Tagle congratulated the diocese on its spiritual, communal, pastoral, and missionary efforts during the jubilee’s preparatory phase and looked forward to the post-jubilee period.
